handoff: Planet panel: each lane whose engine.lane_full is true gets an upgrade line under its ship rows (before the cost detail). Level 2: the line reads as taken, no button. Lanes that are not full show nothing. Pressing calls main.upgrade_route; a refusal goes to post_notice. See it: debug menu, set ships, make 3 energy routes on one lane (full at 16 units x 3 vs 40), open the source planet. Not checked by eye: line width and wrapping in the 320 px panel.
